content:
Maya L: Heads up: NexusBank partner POC kickoff blocked. Need quick ops + pricing + security runbook. TLDR: they want a dedicated tenant, SSO (SAML), PCI answers, and an estimate for ~3M tokens/day. Partner expects a co-sell discount. Can we sync?
Derek - Partnerships: On it. Who from eng & security can join? Also timeline? they want an in-person style MCW by next Tue but remote is ok.
Raj P: I can cover runtime + capacity. Quick Q: 3M tokens/day—are those 8k-context or 4k? that affects GPU type and batching.
Maya L: Mostly chat with avg prompt+response ~1k tokens, embeddings occasional. So 1k avg. 3M tokens/day = ~3k requests/day at 1k each (math sanity check).
Olivia C: 3M / 1k = 3k requests/day. If sustained, recommend Dedicated with burst to handle peaks. For POC we can use A10G-backed Dedicated or a quantized L4 instance. Will sketch cost soon.
Raj P: For SSO/SAML we need entityID, ACS URL, and IdP metadata. Put NexusBank IdP contact in the ticket. We can demo SSO on staging; control plane gets only auth assertions, no customer payloads.
OnboardingBot: Ticket created: #POC-5632 assigned to eng-oncall. Link: https://internal/tracker/POC-5632
Derek - Partnerships: Also they dropped a security questionnaire — ~40 Qs. Security asked to return answers by EOD Thursday. Attaching file to the ticket.
Maya L: Linking the questionnaire: https://files.internal/nexusbank/sec-q.pdf (can't upload big PDF in channel)
Raj P: I'll own infra/security-infra answers (networking, tenancy, encryption). Olivia, can you own PCI/compliance sections?
Olivia C: I got PCI. Quick note to call out in responses: we support encryption in transit + at rest; KMS options (AWS KMS / customer-managed HSM for Private); hosted can redact logs. I'll mark any 'No' items.
Maya L: NexusBank asked explicitly for "dedicated tenant in VPC with private peering" — is that Redwood Private or Dedicated? OnboardingBot notes Private requires enterprise contract.
Raj P: That maps to Private deployment. Lead time ~6 weeks for provisioning + network team setup. For POC, propose a bridge: scoped Dedicated instance in partner region + IP allowlist for NexusBank CIDR to minimize friction.
Derek - Partnerships: Partner prefers minimal friction. Suggested path: start on Dedicated (IP allowlist + SSO) then plan migration to Private after contract. Need a 1-slide architecture + step-by-step handoff runbook for partner + eng.
Maya L: Can someone draft 1-slide arch + runbook steps for eng handoff? Include rollback plan: fallback model variant and capacity throttle to keep app online if overloaded.
Raj P: I'll draft the slide and a short terraform snippet for net config. Example snippet: `resource "redwood_dedicated" "nexus" { region = "us-east-1" capacity = "reserved" ip_allowlist = ["203.0.113.0/24"] }`
Olivia C: I'll draft the security responses and a brief FAQ on data residency + logs. Also recommend enabling KV prefix caching + batching to reduce token costs — will include numbers.
Derek - Partnerships: I'll set partner enablement call Wed 10:00 PT. Can both of you make it?
Raj P: Yes, I can.
Olivia C: Yes, I'll be there and bring the draft answers.
OnboardingBot: Reminder: meeting scheduled Wed 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent to participants.
Maya L: Follow-ups: Raj please post a cost estimate by EOD today; Olivia please flag any 'No' answers in the security questionnaire so we can escalate. Tag me when done. :rocket:
Raj P: Will do. Rough B-O-E: with Dedicated reserved + modest autoscale, expect monthly spend roughly $18k-25k for sustained 3M tokens/day. I'll refine with model sizing and quantization.
Olivia C: Got it — will flag PCI items and propose compensating controls where needed. If any blocker, I will escalate to security leads.
Maya L: Thanks team — goal is to have slide + sec answers + cost by EOD so Derek can present to the partner tomorrow.
Derek - Partnerships: Copy that. I'll prep partner-facing next steps doc based on your drafts and include migration path and SLA expectations.
